title: Sunny and Cocoa
moral: Helping others and being kind makes the journey better.

scenes.summary: Sunny rides her horse Cocoa across the land looking for a home.
scenes.text: Sunny rode her little brown horse Cocoa across the wide land. She wore a soft hat and red scarf and had a plan to find a home at Cottonwood Bend.
scenes.image_prompt: young cowgirl riding horse across wide grassy land with blue sky, colorful cartoon children's book style
scenes.story: Sunny rode her little brown horse Cocoa across the wide wide land. The sky was big and blue. The grass waved like a green sea. Sunny was a young cowgirl. She wore a soft hat and a red scarf. She held the reins with gentle hands. Easy Cocoa she said. Cocoa made a quiet snort. Sunny had a brave plan. She wanted to find a home place. A welcome land with water shade and room to grow. In her saddle bag she had a small tin cup a biscuit and a folded map. The map was old and crinkly. It showed a star by a spot called Cottonwood Bend. Sunny looked at the map then at the sun and said west we go. The wind puffed warm and friendly. Soon the trail turned sandy and she followed old wagon tracks. Cocoa slipped on a stone but Sunny stayed calm and helped him steady. They crossed a creek carefully step by step. Soon they saw a fence and a gate left open. Sunny stopped to help and closed the gate. A rancher lady named Mrs Juniper thanked her. Sunny shared food and rested. Then she continued her journey. She reached Cottonwood Bend with trees and a river. She felt happy and safe and knew it could be her home.

scenes.summary: Sunny finds an open gate that could cause trouble for animals.
scenes.text: Sunny saw a gate left open near a ranch. She knew animals could wander away if it stayed open.
